parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

schema.description: Optional, any unique string (a UUID is good), up to 255 characters. Send the same key when you retry: a repeat returns what the first request made (header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`) instead of making it twice. The same key with a different request is 422. Keys last 24 hours, per member.

post.summary: Upload a CSV file to import (Admin)
post.description: The request body is the file itself (UTF-8 CSV), not a form. One row per message, grouped by `ticket_id`. Required columns: `ticket_id`, `subject`, `requester_email`, `message_from` (customer, agent or note), `message_body`, `message_created_at` (ISO 8601). Optional: `status`, `priority`, `channel`, `team`, `tags` (`;` between), `ticket_created_at`, `resolved_at`, `requester_name`, `assignee_email`, `csat_score`, `csat_comment`, `message_id`, `author_name`, `author_email`, and `field.<key>` for custom fields. At most 25 MB (413). The file is deleted when the run ends. Rows that can't be read are listed as warnings and left out; they never stop the import. Accepts `Idempotency-Key`.

will_create.title: Will Create

warnings.title: Warnings

address.title: Address

forward_to.title: Forward To
forward_to.description: Where to forward this address to (set by the server); null: not needed or not set up (e.g. CeDesk reads the mailbox itself).

admin_alerts.description: Email every Admin when a member is added, deactivated or reactivated, the IP list or the 2FA rule changes, or a member's 2FA is reset.

two_factor_required.description: True: ask for the code from the authenticator app and send it to POST /auth/2fa with this token within 10 minutes. Until then every other route answers 403 `TwoFactorRequired`.
